evidenceKind: Ordinary targeted static PE inspection with supplied Pascal and ERM sources. No REA Evidence, no native execution or runtime verification.

contract.storage: Unsigned 4-bit field in bits12..15 of a per-coordinate 32-bit Squares element
contract.writeRule: temp signed32 through ZvsApply, then keep low4 bits; no clamp or negative rejection in PO:N handler
contract.location: Coordinate x/y/z, independent of an object ID, object class or object lifetime; there is no object lookup between coordinate checks and field access.
contract.ordinaryInitialization: Reset loop clears bits12..15 for every coordinate; unrelated bits initialized separately.
contract.persistence: Whole independent Squares and Squares2 arrays saved/restored under Era.PO by ERA event callbacks; binary code agrees with supplied PoTweak.pas.
contract.generalObjectRemovalOrDrop: Not established dynamically or by tracing every object removal/drop hook. The PO handler and save format have no object-ID coupling. Do not add unconditional erase-on-removal semantics on this evidence alone.

rule119Source.initialMark: WOG_101_SetDoubledArtifacts iterates map artifact locations and writes N15 once.
rule119Source.postVisit: After artifact pickup, reads N;0 exits; checks artifact source ID>=7 and no remaining guardians; adds extra copy only when current carried+equipped count<2. Only if earlier N==15 it writes N0.
rule119Source.otherNonzeroValues: Values1..14 also qualify for the post-trigger but are not cleared by its final condition.
rule119Source.dropComment: Source notes N0 usually means a player-dropped artifact. This is a source expectation, not an executed lifecycle proof.
rule119Source.coordinateNotObjectKey: A different object at the same coordinate shares the same PO cell unless some independent path clears it.

examples: Mine protection writes N7, map rule122 reads nonzero and resets N0 to skip one weekly reroll.
Windmill/waterwheel upgrades inspect nonzero N; commented reset lines explicitly preserve the upgrade state.
Other scripted N values share this coordinate nibble, rather than private subsystem namespaces.

selectors.oneSelector: Evaluated index1..9998 into the integer v-array; coordinates come from v[index],v[index+1],v[index+2].
selectors.PO998: Generic v998/v999/v1000 indirection, not intrinsically a current-object ID. Trigger context normally supplies those cells.
selectors.noSelectors: Invalid selector count; not a current-object alias.
selectors.invalidCommandLimit: Resolver error paths return packed0, and PO caller does not explicitly test an error status. No claim of exact continuation/side effects after errors.
selectors.threeSelectors: Coordinates go through32-bit packed-coordinate helper and decode before final map-bounds checks.
selectors.getWriteback: GET still runs final dword store, reinserting the same original nibble read before ZvsApply; maskffff0fff preserves every other bit. This assumes the argument is a normal GET with no independent side effects during evaluation.

regions.name: PO selector resolver arity and variable triplet aliases
regions.observation: Exactly1or3selectors. One selector evaluates integer index, guard1..9998, reads v[index..index+2]. No intrinsic current-object meaning for998. Zero/no selectors are syntax errors, not supported aliases.

regions.name: Coordinates pack helper
regions.observation: 32-bit packed=(y<<16)+x+(z!=0?0x04000000:0). Nonzero z normalized during packing.

regions.name: Coordinates unpack helper
regions.observation: x=packed&1023,y=(packed>>16)&1023,z=unsigned(packed)>=0x04000000. PO map bounds checked after this decode; arbitrary out-of-range arguments can normalize nontrivially.

regions.name: PO receiver dispatch tables
regions.observation: N maps to table index3 and handler0x73bc5b.

regions.name: PO coordinate guards and original coordinate addressing
regions.observation: x/y checked >=0 and < map size; z checked >=0 and <= level bound. Original first array uses x*0x480+y*8+z*4, patched by ERA to current map size stride.

regions.name: PO:N parameter arity, unsigned nibble read, four-byte apply and nibble write
regions.observation: Exactly one argument. GET temp=(square >>12)&15. ZvsApply(&temp,4,subcmd,0). Stored square=(square&0xffff0fff)|((temp&15)<<12). No saturation/range clamp.

regions.name: Initial ERM square reset, including N clearing
regions.observation: Nested x/y/z loops; owner/flag initialization and square&0xffff0fff clear N. ERA patches map bounds and square base refs.

regions.name: PoTweak patched independent square base and dynamic strides
regions.observation: Allocations/base references match supplied PoTweak.pas; patches PO handler base immediate73bb32 and x stride73bb28. Squares address c3d784; Squares2 cbd784. Sizes mapSize^2*2*4 and mapSize^2*2*16.

regions.name: PoTweak save callbacks and Era.PO section name
regions.observation: Both arrays written to section Era.PO; size globals and independent array bases passed to save helper.

regions.name: PoTweak load callback and Era.PO section name
regions.observation: Patch refs first, then restore both arrays from Era.PO.

regions.name: PoTweak WoG initialization hook and old save path disabling
regions.observation: Old squares/squares2 save/load code disabled; hook75259e fires before reset to patch array bases and strides.
